title: Sweep the editor tabs: layout, assets, store, maps, world, shard

steps.say: The layout: every dock and tab is where it should be.
Assets, Art: browse a tile and see it drawn.
Assets, Gumps: the client's interface art.
Assets, Animations: a creature and its frames.
The UO Store: packs for shard owners and authors.
Assets, Maps, then jump into the UO World tab.
World tab: pick a tile and inspect it.
